identifier_normalization.site_name_rule: strip leading and trailing whitespace only
identifier_normalization.reason: 2022 contains trailing-space site identifiers; this response-independent normalization reconciles 92 raw-string common sites to 93 normalized common sites
identifier_normalization.example_equivalence: Dutchtown Campsite Pond == Dutchtown Campsite Pond<space>

high_effort_universe.source_pool_rule: 2021 site with convertible 2021 geometry and at least one perc_surveyed=100 visit
high_effort_universe.evaluation_rule: normalized site present in both 2021 and 2022, convertible 2021 geometry, and at least one perc_surveyed=100 visit in each year

geometry.transformation: NAD27 UTM13 EPSG:26713 -> NAD83 UTM13 EPSG:26913; NAD83 unchanged
geometry.source_coordinate_rule: median transformed 2021 easting/northing per normalized site_name

local_reference.fish_ever_present: 1 if any 2021 Y; 0 if at least one 2021 N and no Y; missing otherwise
